name: Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS) Hub & Services
overview: PACS are the village-level cooperative credit societies providing multi-dimensional agricultural credit, subsidized inputs (fertilizer, certified seeds), farm machinery hiring, and direct market linkage to small and marginal farmers.

services.name: Subsidized Fertilizer Distribution (IFFCO/KRIBHCO)
services.description: Sale of subsidized Urea, DAP, and NPK fertilizers through Aadhaar biometric Point-of-Sale (POS) machines at government-controlled prices (e.g. ₹266.50 per 45kg Urea bag).

services.name: Short-Term Crop Loans (KCC)
services.description: Disbursement of concessional crop loans at 7% normal interest, effectively 4% with prompt repayment subvention.

services.name: Certified Seed & Pesticide Distribution
services.description: Distribution of certified, high-yielding crop seeds with government subsidy verification.

services.name: Custom Hiring Centers (CHC) for Farm Equipment
services.description: Tractors, rotavators, combine harvesters, and drones rented out to small farmers at nominal hourly rates.

services.name: National PACS Computerization Project
services.description: Digitization of PACS on unified cloud ERP software directly linked to NABARD and District Central Cooperative Banks (DCCBs).

fertilizer_rules.verification_mode: Aadhaar authentication via POS machine mandatory
